title: Silver Zoom Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Logistics Businesses
summary: Explains the Silver Zoom Card referral program: earn a $150 referral bonus for each approved referred logistics business that completes $7,500 in purchases within 90 days of account opening. Bonuses cap at 10 per calendar year; no new referrals accepted after 2025-10-01. Bonuses are typically issued after the spend requirement is met and are not issued if the requirement isn’t met or purchases are returned.
faqs: How much is the referral bonus for the Silver Zoom Card?

When do I need to submit/share my referral link, and how is it properly attributed?
